papers.title: Training Language Models via Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Generates structured synthetic sequences with NCAs for a training phase before natural-language pretraining. Studies downstream language modelling and reasoning, including how cellular dynamics and transferred attention layers affect the benefit.

papers.title: Neural Cellular Automata: From Cells to Pixels
papers.summary: Pairs an NCA operating on a coarse grid with a lightweight implicit decoder that converts local cell states and coordinates into appearance. Enables arbitrary-resolution rendering while retaining cellular growth, regeneration and dynamics across grid and mesh domains.

papers.title: Learning PDE Time-Stepping with Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Learns a shared local cellular rule as a time-stepping surrogate for partial differential equations. Tests long-horizon prediction on heat, advection, Burgers, Allen–Cahn and Fisher–KPP dynamics against other learned solvers.

papers.title: Neural Cellular Automata Learn General Features in their Hidden Channels
papers.summary: Analyses the features represented in hidden NCA channels and transfers a teacher’s internal states to a student during early training. Evaluates few-shot classification and scale generalisation on MNIST, separating feature extraction from collective label agreement.

papers.title: RNCA: Self-Repairing Segmentation Masks
papers.venue: Medical Imaging with Deep Learning (MIDL 2026), PMLR 315
papers.summary: Uses image-guided NCA updates to repair imperfect masks produced by other segmentation models. Learns to reconnect fragmented structures and remove loose regions, improving topological consistency for retinal vessels and myocardium.

papers.title: 2D Spatial Reasoning with Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata
papers.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026, accepted)
papers.summary: Introduces adaptive neural cellular automata with input-dependent perceptive fields based on deformable convolutions. Evaluates iterative spatial reasoning on Sudoku, image-based Sudoku and shortest-path maze tasks using compact models with inspectable communication patterns.

papers.title: A New Kind of Network? Review and Reference Implementation of Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Reviews neural cellular automaton architectures, training and applications using a common modular notation. Introduces NCAtorch as an open-source reference implementation for reproducible experiments.

papers.title: Applications of Neural Cellular Automata: State of the Art, Challenges and Opportunities
papers.summary: Surveys NCA architectural variations and practical applications, with particular attention to medical image analysis. Discusses efficiency, robustness, segmentation, registration, depth estimation and opportunities for further research.

papers.title: NCAdapt: Dynamic adaptation with domain-specific Neural Cellular Automata for continual hippocampus segmentation
papers.summary: Introduces domain-specific adaptation layers for an NCA backbone used in continual hippocampus segmentation. Freezes the shared backbone after initial training and learns compact additions for new domains to limit forgetting and retraining costs.

papers.title: MedSegDiffNCA: Diffusion Models With Neural Cellular Automata for Skin Lesion Segmentation
papers.summary: Combines neural cellular automata with diffusion models for skin lesion segmentation. Multilevel refinement and spatial and channel attention aim to reduce model size while retaining segmentation quality.

papers.title: Neural cellular automata: applications to biology and beyond classical AI
papers.summary: Reviews neural cellular automata for biological and bioengineering applications. Discusses learned local interactions as models of development, regeneration and adaptive behaviour across biological scales.

papers.title: EngramNCA: a Neural Cellular Automaton Model of Memory Transfer
papers.summary: Separates visible cell states from private memory channels to model decentralised memory transfer. Interacting automata encode, propagate and grow different morphologies from shared internal information.

papers.title: MED-NCA: Bio-inspired medical image segmentation
papers.summary: Extends the Med-NCA and M3D-NCA line of work to a broader evaluation across eight anatomies and multiple imaging modalities. Studies compact segmentation models, robustness, quality control and tools for visualising cellular inference.

papers.title: Neural Cellular Automata for ARC-AGI
papers.summary: Applies gradient-trained cellular update rules to abstract grid transformations from ARC-AGI. Evaluates few-shot generalisation and examines how architectural and training choices affect precise transformations of input grids.

papers.title: CAX: Cellular Automata Accelerated in JAX
papers.summary: Presents a modular JAX library for hardware-accelerated cellular automaton research. Supports discrete, continuous and neural automata, with examples covering growth, classification and other emergent behaviours.

papers.title: Multi-texture synthesis through signal responsive neural cellular automata
papers.summary: Uses internally encoded genomic signals to generate several textures with a single compact NCA. Studies interpolation, coexistence and editing of learned textures while preserving regeneration after damage.

papers.title: Learning spatio-temporal patterns with Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Learns local update rules from image time series and partial differential equation trajectories. Extends NCA modelling to transient and stable spatial patterns, including Turing pattern dynamics.

papers.title: Latent Neural Cellular Automata for Resource-Efficient Image Restoration
papers.summary: Moves neural cellular automaton updates into the latent space of a pretrained autoencoder. Applies this approach to image restoration to lower computational requirements while preserving reconstruction quality.

papers.title: Mesh Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Generalises cellular updates to vertices of triangle meshes to synthesise dynamic surface textures without UV maps. Supports image, text and motion supervision, generalisation to unseen meshes and interactive texture grafting.

papers.title: NoiseNCA: Noisy Seed Improves Spatio-Temporal Continuity of Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Investigates whether texture NCAs learn continuous dynamics or overfit their training discretisation. Uses noisy initial states to improve consistency across spatial resolutions and time steps, enabling continuous controls over pattern scale and growth speed.

papers.title: Frequency-Time Diffusion with Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Uses neural cellular automata as compact diffusion-model backbones. Adds Fourier-based diffusion to support communication over larger spatial distances, with image generation, inpainting and super-resolution examples.

papers.title: An Organism Starts with a Single Pix-Cell: A Neural Cellular Diffusion for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
papers.summary: Introduces generative cellular automata inspired by growth from a single cell. Evaluates cellular image synthesis as data augmentation for retinal disease classification in fundus and OCT images.

papers.title: Reconstructing Microstructures From Statistical Descriptors Using Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Trains an NCA to reconstruct material microstructures from statistical descriptors, which can be obtained from a single reference. Separates training cost from output size so that large or repeated reconstructions can be generated efficiently.

papers.title: Emergent Dynamics in Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Studies how the number of state channels and hidden neurons in the update network relate to emergent motion. Proposes an architectural design principle for generating dynamic rather than stationary NCA patterns.

papers.title: DyNCA: Real-time Dynamic Texture Synthesis Using Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Introduces DyNCA for real-time synthesis of dynamic textures with controllable motion. Learns appearance and motion from separate targets and supports arbitrary video duration and frame size after training.

papers.title: Growing Steerable Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Allows each cell to adjust its own orientation through an internal state. Studies how this steerable perception supports pattern growth, rotational symmetry breaking and chirality.

papers.title: Neural cellular automata for solidification microstructure modelling
papers.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
papers.summary: Uses neural cellular automata to predict how metal microstructures develop during solidification. Learned local updates provide a data-driven alternative to conventional cellular automaton simulations.

papers.title: M3D-NCA: Robust 3D Segmentation with Built-in Quality Control
papers.summary: Uses multilevel patchification to apply compact NCAs to three-dimensional medical image segmentation. Derives a quality metric from prediction variability to identify segmentation errors without relying solely on a final mask.

papers.title: Med-NCA: Robust and Lightweight Segmentation with Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Introduces a two-stage NCA pipeline that communicates global context at low resolution before segmenting high-resolution patches. Evaluates compact models for hippocampus and prostate segmentation, including robustness and deployment on limited hardware.

papers.title: Hierarchical Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Explores hierarchical neural cellular automata as models of organisation across multiple scales. Investigates how locally interacting units can form higher-level, goal-directed structures.

papers.title: Growing Isotropic Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Introduces isotropic neural cellular automata whose update rules do not depend on a globally shared orientation. Uses structured seeds or rotation- and reflection-invariant training objectives to learn asymmetric patterns.

papers.title: HyperNCA: Growing Developmental Networks with Neural Cellular Automata
papers.venue: ICLR 2022 — From Cells to Societies workshop
papers.summary: Uses an NCA as a hypernetwork that grows the weights of a neural-network controller. Evaluates the resulting developmental networks on reinforcement-learning tasks and explores transformations between related tasks.

papers.title: Attention-based neural cellular automata
papers.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
papers.summary: Uses attention to parameterise interactions between neighbouring cells. Explores attention-based local update rules as an alternative to convolution-based neural cellular automata for pattern generation.

papers.title: Variational neural cellular automata
papers.summary: Combines a variational latent representation with a cellular growth process to generate diverse images. Studies reconstruction, probabilistic generation and recovery of learned stable patterns after damage.

papers.title: Goal-Guided Neural Cellular Automata: Learning to Control Self-Organising Systems
papers.venue: ICLR 2022 — From Cells to Societies workshop
papers.summary: Introduces goal encodings that steer cellular behaviour throughout growth rather than fixing a single target in advance. Investigates changing goals and maintaining task performance when only some cells receive the control signal.

papers.title: A Unified Substrate for Body-Brain Co-evolution
papers.summary: Presents a neural cellular robot substrate in which a single NCA develops a modular robot’s body and controls its activity. Uses evolutionary optimisation and quality-diversity search to explore robot morphologies across benchmark tasks.

papers.title: Learning graph cellular automata
papers.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
papers.summary: Extends learned cellular automaton rules from regular grids to arbitrary graphs using graph neural networks. Evaluates rule learning on irregular tessellations, flocking behaviour and convergence to target states.

papers.title: Adversarial Reprogramming of Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Investigates how crafted perturbations can redirect the behaviour of a trained neural cellular automaton. Demonstrates reprogramming of self-organising dynamics without changing the learned update rule.

papers.title: Self-Organising Textures
papers.summary: Trains neural cellular automata to synthesise textures through repeated local updates. Explores texture formation as a self-organising process that can run on grids of different sizes.

papers.title: Step bunches, nanowires and other vicinal “creatures”—ehrlich–schwoebel effect by cellular automata
papers.summary: Models crystal surface growth with cellular automata incorporating Ehrlich–Schwoebel barriers. Explores the emergence of step bunches, nanowires and other surface structures.

papers.title: Generative adversarial neural cellular automata
papers.summary: Introduces GANCA, combining neural cellular automata with adversarial training. A single automaton generates different outputs from different initial conditions and is evaluated on inputs beyond its training distribution.

papers.title: Growing 3D Artefacts and Functional Machines with Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Extends neural cellular automata to three-dimensional growth using Minecraft as an experimental environment. Demonstrates construction of complex structures and regeneration of parts of functional moving machines.

papers.title: Growing Neural Cellular Automata
papers.summary: Trains a shared neural update rule to grow a target image from a single seed cell. Explores persistent patterns and regeneration after damage as models of morphogenesis.

papers.title: Self-classifying MNIST Digits
papers.summary: Trains cells to recognise handwritten digits using only local communication. Digit labels emerge across the grid as cells exchange information through repeated neural updates.

papers.title: Image segmentation via cellular automata
papers.summary: Formulates image segmentation as an iterative cellular process. Cells exchange local information and learn update rules that collectively produce pixel-level segmentation predictions.

papers.title: Cellular automata as convolutional neural networks
papers.summary: Connects cellular automaton rules with convolutional neural network representations. Demonstrates how convolutional models can reproduce and learn local cellular dynamics.

papers.title: Deformable Convolutional Networks
papers.summary: Introduces convolution and region-of-interest pooling with learned spatial offsets. These modules adapt their sampling locations to image geometry rather than using a fixed sampling grid.

papers.title: ‘Go or grow’: the key to the emergence of invasion in tumour progression?
papers.venue: Mathematical medicine and biology: a journal of the IMA
papers.summary: Tests whether switching between migration and proliferation, together with oxygen shortage, can explain invasive tumour growth. Uses a lattice-gas cellular automaton to investigate the “go or grow” hypothesis.

papers.title: Cellular automata: a discrete view of the world
papers.summary: Provides an introduction to cellular automata, their dynamics and their use in modelling complex systems. Covers one- and two-dimensional rules, chaos and patterns arising from simple local interactions.

papers.title: The geometry and pigmentation of seashells
papers.venue: Nottingham: Department of Mathematical Sciences, University of Nottingham
papers.summary: Examines mathematical descriptions of seashell geometry and pigmentation. Connects shell growth and visible patterns with simple generative and pattern-forming mechanisms.

papers.title: Universality in elementary cellular automata
papers.summary: Proves that the elementary cellular automaton Rule 110 can perform universal computation. Establishes that a simple one-dimensional local rule can support arbitrarily complex computation.

papers.title: A new kind of science
papers.summary: A review of Wolfram’s proposal that simple computational rules can account for complex natural behaviour. The library citation refers to the 2003 Applied Mechanics Reviews entry; the summary source links to the underlying book.

papers.title: A cellular automaton describing the formation of spatially ordered structures in chemical systems
papers.summary: Presents a cellular automaton for spatial pattern formation in chemical systems. Local excitation and recovery rules reproduce organised waves and related structures in reaction media.

papers.title: Fibroblasts, morphogenesis and cellular automata
papers.summary: Discusses fibroblasts and biological form through the perspective of cellular automata. Connects local cellular organisation with the modelling of morphogenesis.

papers.title: Statistical mechanics of cellular automata
papers.summary: Studies cellular automata as discrete models of statistical physics. Examines how local deterministic rules generate ordered, periodic and complex collective behaviour.

papers.title: MATHEMATICAL GAMES - The fantastic combinations of John Conway's new solitaire game "life"
papers.summary: Introduces Conway’s Game of Life through its local birth and survival rules. Shows how simple interactions produce moving, oscillating and growing configurations.

papers.title: Theory of self-reproducing automata
papers.summary: Develops a formal account of machines capable of constructing copies of themselves. Its cellular automaton construction connects self-reproduction, universal computation and descriptions of machines.
